_doc: TEMPLATE STORY SCENES. A scene binds a background image, a music track, and an entry dialogue node. Chapter/act/milestone fields feed the spoken Quest Recap and the debug chapter-warp menu — no story metadata is hardcoded in engine classes.

scenes.name: The Proving Grounds
scenes.ambientDescription: An ancient vaulted chamber where stone glyphs hum in resonance with spoken incantations.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You entered the proving grounds, learned to speak commands aloud, and tested your voice in trial combat.
scenes.defaultObjective: Speak with the chronicle, learn the mechanics, and run the combat trials.

scenes.name: The Echo Hall
scenes.ambientDescription: A vast hall of polished stone where every spoken word returns twice, testing the clarity of your intent.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You rested in the Echo Hall, then faced the Proving Guardian and conquered its phased assault.
scenes.defaultObjective: Rest to restore the party, then defeat the Proving Guardian.

scenes.name: The Hiring Kiosk
scenes.ambientDescription: A flickering CRT terminal with peeling motivational stickers in the vestibule.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You completed the pre-employment assessment and received your badge assignment.
scenes.defaultObjective: Complete the assessment and choose your department.

scenes.name: The Associate Locker Room
scenes.ambientDescription: Battleship-gray metal lockers, ozone smell, and fluorescent hum.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Donna assigned you Locker 42 and taught you the three golden rules of survival.
scenes.defaultObjective: Report to the Morning Huddle in Action Alley.

scenes.name: Center Action Alley
scenes.ambientDescription: Associates gather around Henderson's yellow milk crate between paper towel towers.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Henderson held the morning huddle and demanded the store cheer.
scenes.defaultObjective: Survive the morning cheer and report to your station.

scenes.name: Front-End Concourse
scenes.ambientDescription: Beeping barcode scanners, squeaking carts, and an endless line of customers.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You clocked in for your very first shift and engaged the rush crowd.
scenes.defaultObjective: Defend Register 4 against the customer rush.
